constraints: If offset is omitted, reading starts at the beginning of the BLOB (byte 0).
The BLOB's data must have previously been produced by LIST TO BLOB for the created list to be well-formed.

overloadMerges.note: offset is documented/arrow-marked in the parameter table as inout ('<->': input starting byte position, output updated to the position just after the value read), even though the draft parser defaulted it to direction:in.

params.name: offset
params.description: Byte offset to read the hierarchical-list data from; on return, updated to the offset immediately following the data read.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Creates a new hierarchical list from data stored in blob at the given (or default) byte offset, advancing offset past the data read, and returns the new list's reference number.

_needsReview: offset is typed plain Integer here (unlike the analogous BLOB to integer command, where the equivalent updated-in-place offset parameter is typed Variable), yet the docs still describe it as updated with 'New offset after reading' -- left as inout per the parameter table's arrow, but this may be a doc inconsistency worth checking against the live command's actual pass-by-reference behavior.
